title: stardust rollout/coverage/pages.json
description: Delivery ledger: one row per migrated page rollout is responsible for delivering to AEM-EDS, plus one per typed row (chrome fragment, fragment, index sheet) seeded by inventory --content. Built by inventorying stardust/migrated/. Tracks the source hash (for stale detection) and per-page delivery status; update-coverage and verify write the delivery block. Owned by stardust:rollout; the agnostic core is never modified.

path.description: Destination path on the delivered site, e.g. /blog/scaling-teams.

templateId.description: The template grouping this page belongs to (rollout/coverage/templates.json[].id). Drives delivery order and block reuse.

representative.description: Archetypes-only mode: slug of the archetype this content-pending sibling clones.

migratedHtml.description: Path, e.g. stardust/migrated/blog/scaling-teams.html; null for content-pending and typed rows.

sourceHash.description: Content hash of the migrated HTML (or the typed row's content file / the roster's currentStatePath); changes mark the page stale for re-delivery.

currentStatePath.description: content-pending rows: the state.json currentStatePath the hash was taken from.

contentFile.description: Typed rows: the EDS content file (nav*.html, fragments/**, *.json) the row was seeded from.

missing.description: Typed rows: the source file was gone on the last --content run; the row is kept, never dropped.

status.description: content-pending = rostered from state.json, no migrated HTML yet; stale = source hash changed after a prior delivery, needs re-delivery. Lifecycle: reference/coverage-model.md.

type.description: Artifact type; unset means page. Drives the verify render check (fragment: no <h1> rule; index: JSON data[]) and the sitemap (page rows only).

deployedPath.description: Served path when it differs from path (redirect Source -> Destination); written by update-coverage --from-ledger or seeded by inventory --redirects.

pendingLinks.description: verify: internal link targets that are coverage rows not yet delivered (advisory; the page stays verified).

outsideLinks.description: verify under links.outsideInventory: warn - internal link targets that are no coverage row (the page stays verified).

gates.description: Per-page gate results ingested by update-coverage --gate <name> <json> / verify --ai-readability (reference/measured-gates.md § Gate 5, § Gate 6). Copied from the instrument's artifact, never typed. unmeasured = the instrument gave no verdict; the row's status is untouched.

gate.description: Published-origin PAGE gate (gate-publish.mjs --report / verify.mjs --gate-report; reference/publish-gate.md § Gate 8). Read from stardust/rollout/gate-report.json, never typed. Under flow: replica a row is verified only with status pass.

status.description: pass = every configured breakpoint PASS; unmeasured = an instrument gave no verdict (exit 124 / 5 / 6, crops not run) — never a FAIL; ungated = no published-origin record.

report.description: Path of the gate-report.json the block was copied from.
